_comment: Merge this into your Claude Desktop config, then fully quit and relaunch Claude Desktop (a window close is not enough). On Windows the file lives at %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. This connects through agentgateway (governance + audit logging in front of the MCP server) rather than spawning the Python server directly. Claude Desktop's config file does not support a plain remote 'type: http' entry, so this uses the 'mcp-remote' bridge (npx) to speak stdio to Desktop while proxying to the gateway over Streamable HTTP. Start, in order: Data API (uvicorn data_api.main:app --port 8000), then agentgateway (backend/mcp_server/gateway/ — see README 'agentgateway'). Requires Node/npx on PATH.
